title.narrative: Promotion of Small Hydro Power (SHP) for productive use and energy services in Burundi

description.narrative: The project aims to scale up of SHP for rural electrification and productive uses in small and medium sized industries. The project will contribute to the twin goals of ending extreme poverty and boosting shared prosperity. Currently, power shortages and the cost of power from expensive thermal power plants constrain the economic growth. The proposed project aims at promoting SHP plants for electricity generation for productive uses in potential sites.
